title: UL 🫪
author: Michael Aslanidis
desc: Introducing the UL 🫪 program, an 18-week journey designed for intermediate lifters ready to elevate their bodybuilding and athletic performance. With 109 workouts averaging 70 minutes each, this comprehensive plan incorporates a variety of machine and cable exercises targeting all major muscle groups, ensuring balanced development and strength gains. Expect to challenge yourself with high-intensity sets and focused muscle engagement, pushing your limits week after week. Get ready to transform your physique and enhance your athletic prowess with a structured approach that delivers results!
